name: Quote card
description: A quotation card for feeds. A solid accent dot at the top left, the quote in four big flush-left lines below it, a soft circle in the second colour bleeding off the bottom right corner, and the speaker's name and role at the foot over a short accent rule. Calm, readable and shareable.
use: quotes, testimonials, reviews, sayings, announcements in one sentence, tips, facts, thank-you posts

quote.description: the quote size; code shrinks it until the longest line fits between the margins

labels.description: the size of the name and role

slots.name: quote
slots.description: the quotation broken into four lines of similar length, at natural pauses; no quotation marks

slots.name: by
slots.description: who said it, then their role or where it is from

art.description: an accent dot above the quote and a soft circle bleeding off the bottom right
art.shapes:
Let there be a circle called dot, {{W * 0.045}} big, at {{left + W * 0.045}} {{top + W * 0.045}}.
Make the dot pop.
Let there be a circle called orb, {{W * 0.31}} big, at {{W * 0.95}} {{H * 0.95}}.
Make the orb {{c.second}}.
art.stamp:
Let there be a circle called dot, {{W * 0.045}} big, at {{left + W * 0.045}} {{top + W * 0.045}}.
Make the dot pop.
place a {{stamp}} at {{W * 0.8}} {{H * 0.8}}, size {{W * 0.13}}.
art.asset:
Let there be a circle called dot, {{W * 0.045}} big, at {{left + W * 0.045}} {{top + W * 0.045}}.
Make the dot pop.
Let there be a circle called photo, {{W * 0.23}} big, at {{W * 0.86}} {{H * 0.86}}.
Print @{{asset}} in the photo.
